title: A new account made outside the /join induction still gets its first touch, referral credit, cohort tag and welcome

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: persistAcquisition, applyReferralAttribution, tagFunnelCohort, the beta Crew comp, sendWelcomeEmail and persona nurture run only inside writeInduction (app/join/(induction)/actions.ts:350-497); the only other caller, app/onboarding/actions.ts:98, is unreachable while FUNNEL_INDUCTION_ACTIVE is true. Accounts made through /launch-your-business, the four quick builders, Google from those pages, or /sign-in 'create a new account' get none of it. Production 2026-11-27: of 26 profiles created since 21 Sep, 14 carry no acquisition at all, and in every week the stamped count equals the onboarded count exactly. Because the Crew comp is skipped, a builder sign-up also cannot take donations on a free Space while an induction sign-up can (lib/pricing/paying-accounts.ts). Fix: one post-sign-up module called from the auth callback, password finish and /launch/claim that runs the account-level side effects idempotently; the induction keeps only its own answers.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
